title: Find every file containing an exact token across a 200-file tree
prompt: In the current working directory there is a source tree under src/. Exactly some of its files contain the exact token NEEDLE_X7Q. Find every file under src/ whose content contains that token, and write their paths to matches.txt: one path per line, relative to the working directory with forward slashes, sorted ascending (lexicographically), and nothing else in the file - no line numbers, no counts, no blank line at the end beyond the final newline.
